name: Guadalix de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Guadalix de la Sierra (mountains above a bridge).
history: Municipal flag of Guadalix de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Guadalix de la Sierra arms — snowy mountains above a bridge
bridge and crown of the arms
